title: Check-in scanner
subtitle: Scans queue on this phone and sync whenever a connection is available.

categories.heading: Extra points for this check-in
categories.hint: Select any that apply, then scan or check in — they reset after each person.

camera.permissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
camera.genericError: Couldn't start the camera on this device. Use manual check-in instead.

preflight.blockedBody: This device has never downloaded this event's roster, and there's no signal to get one now. Check-in cannot start until you get connected — find a signal before doors open.
preflight.needsDownloadBody: Download the roster now, before you lose signal at the venue.
preflight.downloadError: Couldn't download the roster. Check your connection and try again.
preflight.readyTitle_one: Ready for offline use — {{count}} member downloaded
preflight.readyTitle_other: Ready for offline use — {{count}} members downloaded

stale.label: Code expired
stale.body: Ask them to refresh their screen and try again.

invalid.label: Not a Karma code
invalid.body: This isn't a valid check-in code. Try again or use manual check-in.

unknown.label: Unknown member
unknown.body: This code doesn't match anyone on the roster.

sync.lastAttemptFailed: Couldn't reach the server on the last attempt. Still queued — it'll retry automatically.
sync.rejectedHelp: These were NOT recorded: the server refused them, so no check-in or points were saved. Fix the cause or use Manual, then dismiss.

reasons.outside_event_window: Not recorded: the event isn't happening now. Check-ins are accepted from 3 hours before the start until 3 hours after the end.
reasons.member_not_found: Not recorded: this person's account wasn't found.
reasons.event_not_found: Not recorded: this event no longer exists.
reasons.stale_code: Not recorded: the QR code had expired. Ask them to show the live code.
reasons.bad_signature: Not recorded: the QR code didn't verify. Ask them to refresh their code.
reasons.missing_signature: Not recorded: the QR code didn't verify. Ask them to refresh their code.
reasons.malformed: Not recorded: the code couldn't be read.
reasons.error: Not recorded: something went wrong on the server. Try again or use Manual.

walkIn.title: Walk-in attendee
walkIn.subtitle: For someone who isn't a Karma member. This records their attendance today, not a member account.
walkIn.success: Walk-in queued. It'll sync automatically once you're back online.

fields.confirmedAdult: I confirm this person is 18 or older.
fields.waiverAcknowledged: I confirm this person has read and accepted the liability waiver and the photo and media release.

errors.adultRequired: You must confirm the attendee is 18 or older.
errors.waiverRequired: You must confirm the waiver and the photo and media release were acknowledged.
errors.noWaiverVersion: The current waiver text hasn't been downloaded to this device yet. Connect to the internet once to enable walk-ins offline.
